FOREST CONSERVATION ORDINANCE

THE order under section 3. that has to be read with Section 64 (1) of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451),as No. 13 of 1966, as amended by Acts, No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of2009 that have to be read with Section 51 of the 19th amendment of the Constitution of Democratic Socialist Republic ofSri Lanka.
The Order

By virtue of powers vested in me by section 3. of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) as amendedby Acts, No. 13 of 1966, No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, that haveto be read with Section 51 of the 19th amendment of the Constitution of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka,I, Maithripala Sirisena, President do by this order declare the Paspolakanda Mukalana Alias Wedikanda Mukalana Forestof 38.653 hectares bounded by the limit set forth in the schedule hereto as Paspolakanda Mukalana Alias WedikandaMukalana Reserved Forest from 15th day of July, 2019.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA,President.
Colombo,15th day of July 2019.
